title: Agents' Last Exam accepted to NeurIPS 2026
body: A large collaborative benchmark for evaluating AI agents on long-horizon professional tasks, has been accepted to the Evaluations and Datasets track at NeurIPS 2026. I am glad to contribute to testing agent capability limits in using digital interfaces for historical knowledge work.

title: Presented at DHC 2026 in Sheffield
body: Presented Beyond Lexical Reuse: Evaluating Semantic Search for 18th-Century Intellectual History through the Case of Locke in the Digital Humanities Congress 2026 programme.

title: CASCADE Training Camp 4 in Sheffield
body: Joined CASCADE Camp 4 on Questions & Methods, with sessions on career pathways, communicating research to non-specialists, and applying research skills in an industry setting.

title: Proof-of-concept paper on semantic search for intellectual history accepted at NLP4DH 2026
body: The paper combines a historian-built semantic taxonomy with expert annotation to evaluate dense retrieval through the case of Locke's reception.

title: Attended Digital Language Sovereignty – Euskadi–Finland AI & Language in Helsinki
body: Participated in the Helsinki event, which addressed digital language sovereignty, low-resource languages, language models, datasets, and research infrastructures.

title: Presented at EACL 2026 in Rabat
body: Presented Detecting Latin in Historical Books with Large Language Models: A Multimodal Benchmark at the 19th Conference of the European Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics.

title: Latin detection benchmark paper accepted at EACL 2026
body: Our multimodal benchmark for extracting Latin fragments from noisy, mixed-language historical books was accepted to the main conference.

title: CASCADE Convention 1 in Leuven
body: Joined the first CASCADE Convention, focused on presenting doctoral research, discussing data and methods, exchanging feedback, and connecting with the MECANO training network.

title: Presented at Nordic AI Meet 2025 in Norrköping
body: Presented the ongoing work Detecting Latin in Historical Books with Large Language Models: A Multimodal Benchmark in Norrköping, Sweden.

title: Presented at FCAI AI Day 2025 in Espoo
body: Presented the ongoing work Detecting Latin in Historical Books with Large Language Models: A Multimodal Benchmark in Espoo, Finland.

title: CASCADE Training Camp 3 in Helsinki
body: Joined CASCADE Camp 3 on the interplay between data, questions, and methods, with colleagues from King's College London, the University of Turku, and the University of Helsinki Computational History Group.

title: CASCADE Training Camp 2 in Saarbrücken
body: Joined CASCADE Camp 2 on research design, with contributions from Varieng Helsinki and the University of Glasgow.

title: CASCADE Training Camp 1 in Sheffield
body: Joined the first CASCADE Training Camp to meet the doctoral network, learn about each other's research, and discuss the requirements of the programme.
